headline: Public hearings on a tennis club at 575 Broad Street, a 7Brew restaurant at 650 Farmington Avenue, and earth excavation zoning rules.
summary: Hearings on the 575 Broad Street racquet club were continued from October 19. Earth removal for a Grassy Road home lot and a proposed nine-year permit rule are also up for review.
items: Special permit for a gas station at 34 Farmington Avenue (Application #2584)
Site plan for a convenience store and gas station at 34 Farmington Avenue (Application #2585)
Special permit for earth removal over 400 cubic yards on a Grassy Rd. lot (Application #2580)
Site plan for earth removal over 400 cubic yards on the Grassy Rd. lot (Application #2581)
Public hearing, continued: special permit for a racquet club at 575 Broad Street (Application #2575)
Public hearing, continued: site plan for a racquet club at 575 Broad Street (Application #2576)
Public hearing: zoning amendment to add an earth excavation and reclamation facility use (Application #2577)
Public hearing: special permit for a 7Brew fast food restaurant with a drive-up at 650 Farmington Avenue (Application #2578)
Public hearing: site plan for the 7Brew restaurant at 650 Farmington Avenue and minor site work at 20 Adeline Avenue (Application #2579)
location: City Hall, Council Chambers, First Floor, 111 North Main Street

City of Bristol 
Zoning Commission

6:00 P.M.

                                                                    AGENDA  
1. Call to Order 
2. Pledge of Allegiance 
3. Public Participation 
4. Approval of Minutes 
 a. Regular Meeting — October 19, 2026  
5. Receipt of New Applications  
 a. Application # 2584 — Special Permit for a motor vehicle filling station at 34 
Farmington Avenue; Assessor's Map 24, Lot 221; BG (General Business) zone; Sidi 
Vinayak Petroleum, Inc. applicant/owner. 
 b. Application # 2585 — Site Plan for a convenience store and motor vehicle filling 
station at 34 Farmington Avenue; Assessor's Map 24, Lot 221; BG (General 
Business) zone; Sidi Vinayak Petroleum, Inc. applicant/owner.
6. Planning Commission Referrals 
 a. Application #2580 — Special Permit for Earth Removal in excess of 400 cubic yards 
associated with the development of a residential dwelling lot at Grassy Rd. (Lot 215); 
Assessor's Map 20, Lot 215; R-40 (Single-Family Residential) zone; H&T Holdings of 
Bristol, LLC, applicant. 
 b. Application #2581 — Site Plan for Earth Removal in excess of 400 cubic yards 
associated with the development of a residential dwelling lot at Grassy Rd. (Lot 215); 
Assessor's Map 20, Lot 215; R-40 (Single-Family Residential) zone; H&T Holdings of 
Bristol, LLC, applicant. 
7. Public Hearings 
 a. Application # 2575 — Special Permit for a tennis or racquet club facility at 575 Broad 
Street; Assessor's Map 39, Lot 72; I (General Industrial) zone and BG (General 
Business) zone; Padel Connect CT, LLC, applicant; Bristol NYCEB, LLC, owner — 
PUBLIC HEARING CONTINUED FROM OCTOBER 19, 2026. 
 b. Application # 2576 — Site Plan for a tennis or racquet club facility at 575 Broad 
Street; Assessor's Map 39, Lot 72; I (General Industrial) zone and BG (General 
Business) zone; Padel Connect CT, LLC, applicant; Bristol NYCEB, LLC, owner — 
PUBLIC HEARING CONTINUED FROM OCTOBER 19, 2026. 
 c. Application #2577 — Proposed amendments to the Zoning Regulations to add an 
Earth Excavation and Reclamation Facility use: 1. Delete Article III, Section 
15.2.4.A.1. I-General Industrial zone; 2. Add Section 15.7 Permit Duration – Industrial 
Zones Exceeding Twenty (20) acres with the following requirements: a. parcel must 
be a minimum of twenty (20) acres; b. subject to Special Permit and Site Plan 
applications; c. proposes that Special Permits to be valid for a period of nine (9) 
years; d. proposes the use be located in the (I) General Industrial zone. Attorney 
James Ziogas, applicant. 
 d. Application # 2578 — Special Permit for a fast food restaurant (principal use) and a 
drive-up facility (accessory use) at 650 Farmington Avenue; Assessor's Map 48, Lot 
EPT17+1/8; BG (General Business) zone; 7Brew Company, applicant; CNC Real 
Estate Holdings, LLC, owner. 
 e. Application # 2579 — Site Plan for a fast food restaurant (principal use) and a drive-
up facility (accessory use) at 650 Farmington Avenue and minor site improvements at 
20 Adeline Avenue; Assessor's Map 48, Lot EPT17+1/8 and Lot 20; BG (General 
Business) zone and R-10 (Single-Family Residential) zone; 7Brew Company, 
applicant; CNC Real Estate Holdings, LLC, owner. 
8. Old Business 
9. New Business
10. Staff Reports 
 a. Zoning Report — October 2026  
 b. Commissioner Appointment 
i - R. Martin 
11. Adjournment 
  
REMINDER: The next Regular Meeting of the Zoning Commission is Monday, December 14, 2026
